purpose: Minimum contract before an event can be executed.
steps: 1 Resolve checkpoint state and descendants/branch validity.
3 Pull TECH entries by tags/domain and valid date/host conditions.
4 Resolve each mandatory domain as ACTIVE / NO_RELEVANT_DELTA / NOT_YET_MATURE / UNKNOWN.
5 Merge effects by causal stage; same-intermediate effects integrate once, distinct stages may compound.
6 Apply threshold, allocation/reallocation, schedule and enemy-adaptation checks.
7 Keep provisional bands visible; do not silently convert to point estimates.
8 Emit state transitions and checkpoint delta with provenance.
execution_blockers: mandatory domain unresolved UNKNOWN when material to result and no bounded model exists
gated TECH value used as accepted
blocked checkpoint ancestry used as current state
stale superseded execution artifact used contrary to manifest
historical outcome used directly as upstream input
non_blocking_uncertainty: provisional effect magnitude when sensitivity band can be carried
citation incompleteness that does not alter runtime state
